intro: Since the 2021 coup, Myanmar has been ruled by the military while armed opposition groups control large areas.

chapters.title: Who rules
text: Senior General Min Aung Hlaing led the coup. The military held an election from December 2025 that critics called a sham; its allied party won, and in April 2026 parliament made Min Aung Hlaing president. Aung San Suu Kyi has been in prison since 2021.

chapters.title: Resistance
text: A National Unity Government formed by ousted lawmakers, people's defence forces and long-standing ethnic armed groups fight the military.
